goal: DEPTH: sub-sections / config sections in real integration with the backend — raise real coverage and capability levels
must_build: Every page in ui-spec/gcp/artifacts.json (5 pages; nav: Repositories, Settings)
Backend: core gcp artifactregistry (test_gcp_artifactregistry_core.py): repositories, packages, versions/tags
List / create / detail / edit / delete round-trips through the native API the SDK and CLI use
always: Every page wired to the native API on /_wire (no static data); liveness fixtures for every list/detail page
core/capabilities/gcp/artifacts.json: one entry per console section with an honest level + tests; tests/conformance/test_capabilities.py must pass
Capability feature ids MUST start with 'gcp.' (e.g. 'gcp.artifacts.<section>') — ids share one namespace with the AWS registry
Read the 'Cloud lenses' section of consoles/AGENT-UI.md first — use this cloud's kit, not Cloudscape

depth_targets.title: Permissions (IAM policy)
limitations: getIamPolicy/setIamPolicy/testIamPermissions store and return the policy exactly as configured; Vyomi does not authenticate requests or enforce the bindings.

depth_targets.title: Encryption (customer-managed key)
limitations: A customer-managed key resource name is stored on the repository and returned by the API; Vyomi does not verify the key exists or encrypt stored data with it.

depth_targets.title: Repository mode (remote / virtual)
limitations: Remote and virtual repository configuration is stored and returned; Vyomi does not proxy a remote upstream or aggregate a virtual repository's member repositories.

depth_targets.title: Cleanup policies
limitations: Cleanup policies (and dry-run mode) are stored on the repository and returned by the API; Vyomi does not run them against packages and versions.

depth_targets.title: Vulnerability scanning (Artifact Analysis)
limitations: The vulnerability-scanning setting is stored on the repository and returned by the API; Vyomi does not scan images or report findings.
